evidence.title: Grok Bot: SpaceXAI launches AI Agent to Counter Claude Cowork’s Success
evidence.body: [e001:f01] August 2026, 20:21 Grok Bot. © Screenshot / Canva Set Trending Topics as a preferred source on Google. [e001:f02] SpaceXAI unveiled “Grok Bot” on Tuesday evening, an agent product the company markets as “AI teammates”. [e001:f03] It is the first joint product to come out of the merger of SpaceX/xAI and the AI coding startup Cursor – and an indication that the Cursor brand is likely to disappear in the medium term. [e001:f04] The idea behind Grok Bot: users are meant to hand work to a bot the way they would to a colleague – via chat, without having to configure workflows, automations or routines first. [e001:f05] In product logic and vocabulary, this moves SpaceXAI close to Anthropic’s Claude Cowork: that product is likewise about AI agents for general office work rather than coding alone, about tasks that keep running in the background when the laptop is closed, and about switching between desktop and mobile. [e001:f06] Cowork launched in January 2026 as a desktop app and was extended to web and mobile in July. [e001:f07] In May 2026, the two companies agreed that Anthropic would use the entire capacity of the Colossus 1 data center in Memphis – more than 300 megawatts and over 220,000 Nvidia GPUs – in part to expand capacity for Claude Pro and Claude Max subscriptions. [e001:f08] On it, the bot signs into the tools a team already uses and works across apps, inboxes and websites – explicitly including places where there is no clean API or MCP integration. [e001:f09] As internal examples, the company cites a sales bot that updates CRM entries from call transcripts and prepares follow-ups, an ops bot that onboards new employees and processes invoices received in Gmail, and an engineering bot that reproduces a bug in the product UI, files a ticket and hands the fix off to another bot. [e001:f10] The corporate background: from xAI to SpaceXAI Following its merger with SpaceX, Elon Musk’s AI company xAI has operated under the name SpaceXAI since July 2026; the Grok model brand was retained. [e001:f11] In June 2026 – a few days after the SpaceX IPO – the acquisition of Cursor developer Anysphere for 60 billion US dollars in stock was announced, the largest purchase of a startup to date. [e001:f12] Grok Bot, the general-purpose agent product developed under the internal code name “Sand”, is therefore the first product to make this branding strategy visible. [e001:f13] With Grok Bot, by contrast, the bot’s “own computer” sits in SpaceXAI’s cloud; memory, routines and the credentials stored in the bots for third-party tools are managed there. [e001:f14] Grok Bot is tied to the in-house Grok models and to a paid subscription. [e001:f15] Grok Bot is a closed product that can currently only be used with the SuperGrok Heavy, Cursor Ultra or Cursor Teams Premium plans. evidence.title: SpaceX scrubs Monday launch with busy August on tap including Falcon Heavy mission for NASA
evidence.body: [e002:f01] SpaceX was back on the pad Tuesday with the Space Coast’s 51st orbital launch of the year, part of what’s lining up to be a busy month in Florida. [e002:f02] A Falcon 9 on the Starlink 10-19 mission with 29 Starlink satellites lifted off at 11:58 a.m. from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station’s Space Launch Complex 40. [e002:f03] The launch came after the company scrubbed a Monday attempt. [e002:f04] The first-stage booster for this mission made its 18th trip to space with a recovery landing downrange on the droneship A Shortfall of Gravitas stationed in the Atlantic. [e002:f05] 11, 2026 ahead of a planned launch with 29 Starlink satellites (Courtesy/SpaceX) 1 of 6 A SpaceX Falcon 9 launches with 29 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station's Space Launch Complex 40 on Tuesday, Aug. [e002:f06] 11, 2026. (Courtesy/SpaceX) A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket sits on the pad at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station's Space Launch Complex 40 on Tuesday, Aug. [e002:f07] 11, 2026. (Courtesy/SpaceX) Expand Over the weekend, SpaceX had also put a mission that was delayed from May back on the launch manifest, targeting a liftoff later this week. [e002:f08] The Globalstar 2-R Launch 1 mission, which had been targeting launch on May 18, is now looking to lift off from Cape Canaveral on Saturday during a launch window from 9:12-9:27 p.m. [e002:f09] After that, SpaceX has another Starlink launch targeting August 20. [e002:f10] The rocket, which is essentially three Falcon 9 rockets strapped together, looks to launch NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope headed for a spot 1 million miles from Earth. [e002:f11] SpaceX also has another resupply mission to the International Space Station which could launch sometime in August. [e002:f12] Pictures: 51 Space Coast launches and counting in 2026 SpaceX has flown all but seven of the Space Coast launches so far this year with United Launch Alliance responsible for five, Blue Origin for one and NASA for one. [e002:f13] With all six remaining Atlas V rockets in its stable reserved for Boeing Starliner, ULA’s next launch is likely for its Vulcan rocket, but that is awaiting remedies to two issues since its last launch. [e002:f14] One of those will be fixes to the BE-4 engines provided by Blue Origin, which recently identified a valve on the engine as the likely source for the explosion that destroyed one of its New Glenn rockets on the pad at Canaveral’s Launch Complex 36 earlier this year. [e002:f15] NASA’s Space Launch System rocket, which last flew on this year’s Artemis II mission, won’t fly again until Artemis III targeting launch in mid 2027. evidence.title: 〔東京外為〕ドル、157円台後半＝弱い米雇用統計で下落（10日午前9時）
evidence.body: [e007:f01] 前週末の海外時間には一時156円台後半まで下げる場面もあった。 [e007:f02] 午前9時現在、1ドル＝157円90～90銭と前週末（午後5時、158円39～42銭）比49銭のドル安・円高。 [e007:f03] 先週末の海外市場では、欧州時間は158円30銭前後を軸にもみ合った。 [e007:f04] 米国時間に入ると、7月の米雇用統計がかなり弱い内容となり、一気に156円60銭台に急落。 [e007:f05] いったん持ち直して158円近くに浮上したが、終盤は157円80銭台に伸び悩んだ。 [e007:f06] 週明け東京早朝もおおむね同水準で推移している。 [e007:f07] 7月の米雇用統計は、非農業部門就業者数が前月比2万3000人減と、前月から一転してマイナスとなり、市場予想（ロイター通信調べ）の8万人増を大幅に下回った。 [e007:f08] これを受け、FRBの利上げ観測は後退し、「東京時間も上値の重い展開になる」（為替ブローカー）とみられる。 [e007:f09] ただ、米雇用統計後の急落からは戻り歩調となったため、「いったん下値は試した感もあるため、売りが出ても下げ余地は限られるだろう」（大手邦銀）との声が聞かれる。 [e007:f10] 午前9時前に公表した7月30～31日の日銀決定会合「主な意見」は「想定されたタカ派的な内容であり、大きな反応はみられていない」（先のブローカー）と指摘される。 [e007:f11] ユーロは対円で小安い、対ドルは上昇。 [e007:f12] 午前9時現在、1ユーロ＝182円47～48銭（前週末午後5時、182円52～53銭）、対ドルでは1．1555～1556ドル（同1．1522～1522ドル） 【関連記事】 円大幅安、一時155円台半ば 高市首相「円安容認」観測、株は乱高下―東京市場 【特集】珍現象「ドル安でも円安」、新常態か一過性か 2026年は見極めの年に◇みずほ銀行チーフマーケット・エコノミスト 唐鎌大輔 NY円、157円台後半 米雇用、2万2000人増 予想下回る、失業率は4.3％―8月 円、153円台に急伸 米景気減速懸念で。

evidence.title: 東証、午前終値は６万７０４０円 半導体支えも米株下落波及
evidence.body: [e009:f01] 東京証券取引所 休日明け１２日午前の東京株式市場は、日経平均株価（２２５種）が休日前の１０日終値を挟んで一進一退の展開となった。 [e009:f02] 米半導体株が値上がりし、日本でも一部の関連銘柄が買われ相場を支えた。 [e009:f03] 一方、原油先物価格が上昇し、米国株式市場では主要な株価指数がそろって下落。 [e009:f04] この流れが東京市場に波及して投資家の慎重姿勢が強まった。 [e009:f05] 午前終値は休日前の１０日終値比６９円９６銭高の６万７０４０円１８銭。 [e009:f06] 東証株価指数（ＴＯＰＩＸ）は１３・８０ポイント高の４１１４・４１。 [e009:f07] 米国株式市場での半導体銘柄の上昇を追い風に、東京市場でも業績好調な半導体検査装置大手のアドバンテストなどが値上がりした。

evidence.title: 経常黒字17.4兆円、上半期で過去最大 貿易収支が黒字転換
２６年上半期の経常黒字、過去最大 １７．４兆円、半導体輸出好調―財務省
evidence.body: [e005:f01] アジア向けに半導体など電子部品の輸出が伸びたことを背景に、前年同期と比べ２２．５％増加。 [e005:f02] 上半期としては過去最大の黒字幅となった。 [e005:f03] 財務省、４月３０日に介入、過去最大６兆円 大型連休中、３日で１１．７兆円 モノの取引を示す貿易収支は７４２１億円の黒字（前年同期は１兆４６３６億円の赤字）。 [e005:f04] 半導体のほか自動車の輸出も伸び、黒字に転換した。 [e005:f05] 配当金や利子の収支を示す第一次所得収支は２０兆４９１４億円の黒字で、０．３％増えた。 [e005:f06] 米国の利下げの影響で、海外からの借入金などに対する支払利息が減少した。 [e005:f07] サービス収支は１兆８２２３億円の赤字と、赤字幅が２４３８億円拡大した。 [e005:f08] 訪日客が減少する一方、出国日本人数が増加したことで、旅行収支の黒字幅が縮小したことが響いた。 [e005:f09] 同時に発表された６月の経常収支は９２３億円の赤字だった。 [e005:f10] イラン情勢緊迫化に伴う原油の輸入額拡大などで貿易収支が赤字に転換したほか、日本企業による海外株主への配当金支払いが集中し、第一次所得収支の黒字幅が減少したことが響いた。

evidence.title: The Digital Economy Framework Agreement: Connecting India and ASEAN
evidence.body: [e001:f01] New Delhi should pursue a two-track strategy: digitise goods trade through the ASEAN-India Trade in Goods Agreement while negotiating a related framework for payments, data, cybersecurity and emerging technologies. [e001:f02] The DEFA’s Real Innovation: Managed Interoperability The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) concluded negotiations on the Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA) in Manila in May 2026. [e001:f03] The agreement is ASEAN’s first region-wide digital economy instrument. [e001:f04] Its negotiating agenda spans nine areas, including digital trade, cross-border e-commerce, payments and e-invoicing, digital identity, cross-border data flows and data protection, online safety, cybersecurity and emerging technologies. [e001:f05] The ASEAN Agreement on Electronic Commerce , signed in 2019 and in force since 2021, already committed the ASEAN member states to facilitate electronic transactions while recognising their different laws and levels of regulatory development. [e001:f06] ASEAN’s goal is to reduce regulatory friction, and the negotiated text is not yet public; the depth, exceptions and enforceability of individual commitments can only be seen after signature. [e001:f07] Why the AITIGA May Not be Enough This distinction matters for India because the ASEAN-India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA) is still a trade-in-goods agreement. [e001:f08] ASEAN and India aim to conclude the review in 2026, but the negotiations remain shaped by New Delhi’s concern over its goods deficit and ASEAN’s demand for a simpler and more trade-facilitative agreement. [e001:f09] Incorporating the DEFA into the AITIGA would be counterproductive, broadening a goods-focused negotiation at a late stage while drawing in unresolved questions concerning data governance, privacy, competition and online regulation. [e001:f10] The United Kingdom-India Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement recognises electronic contracts and authentication, promotes compatible digital trading systems and protects consumers while postponing stronger disciplines on cross-border data flows and localisation. [e001:f11] The just concluded European Union-India Free Trade Agreement combines digital-trade rules with an exception to regulate for public policy, privacy and security. [e001:f12] Negotiators should prioritise the legal recognition of electronic trade documents and signatures, interoperable customs and single-window systems, e-invoicing, digital certificates of origin, and faster low-cost payments for firms. [e001:f13] These provisions fall squarely within a modern goods agreement and could make the AITIGA amenable, particularly for smaller businesses. [e001:f14] Another track could establish a separate ASEAN-India Digital Economy Partnership. [e001:f15] India and Singapore can use their payments linkage and wider digital partnership as a pilot, but the regional framework must include capacity support for less developed economies and consultation with small firms. [e001:f16] A two-track approach would do that better than mainstreaming a digital agreement into the AITIGA and better than leaving digital cooperation to bilateral pilots. . . . . .

evidence.title: SCMP signs 3 MOUs in Malaysia to deepen Hong Kong-Asean regional cooperation
evidence.body: [e002:f01] South China Morning Post among delegation signing agreements in Kuala Lumpur to unite policy research, journalism and business networks across Asia. [e002:f02] The South China Morning Post has signed three memorandums of understanding (MOUs) in Kuala Lumpur aimed at deepening regional cooperation and serving as a bridge between Hong Kong, Malaysia and the wider Asean region. [e002:f03] SCMP publisher Tammy Tam on Tuesday signed the MOUs with the Southeast Asian Futures Initiative Centre (SEAFIC), a leading think tank, Star Media Group Berhad, publisher of Malaysia’s leading English-language daily, The Star, and the Malaysian Chamber of Commerce (Hong Kong & Macau) Limited (MayCham). [e002:f04] The SCMP is a Hong Kong-based English-language newspaper owned by Alibaba Group Holding. [e002:f05] The agreements were signed as part of Hong Kong’s biggest delegation to Malaysia to date under the city’s “Think Business, Think Hong Kong” flagship campaign organised by the Trade Development Council. [e002:f06] At the ceremony, Director of Information Services John Tse Chun-chung joined representatives of the Trade Development Council, media outlets and other organisations in signing MOUs witnessed by Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau Ying-wah. [e002:f07] According to the SCMP, the landmark partnerships aim to amplify regional perspectives, enhance mutual understanding and advance forward-looking economic thought leadership across Asia. [e002:f08] “Signing these memorandums of understanding with important partners in Malaysia marks a significant step forward in deepening regional cooperation and serving as a vital bridge between Hong Kong, Malaysia and the wider Asean region,” Tam said. [e002:f09] She said the collaboration would create a dynamic platform combining demand-driven policy insights with credible journalism. [e002:f10] Tam cited SEAFIC’s expertise and forward-looking research capabilities, Star Media Group’s trusted multichannel ecosystem, MayCham’s extensive network, and the SCMP’s global editorial reach and growing influence as an expert voice on China and the region. [e002:f11] “Through our combined professional networks, this collaboration enables us to expand SCMP’s footprint across Southeast Asia while delivering high-impact content and activities that drive informed decision-making, trade and economic development,” she said. [e002:f12] “This partnership with the South China Morning Post is our invitation to the region: let’s start designing solutions to equip ourselves for a more resilient future,” he said. [e002:f13] Star Media Group Berhad group CEO Chan Seng Fatt said of the collaboration with the SCMP: “This MOU marks an important step in strengthening cross-border collaboration and reflects our shared aspiration to explore the opportunities that can be created by bringing together the strengths of Hong Kong and Malaysia.” MayCham deputy chair Helena Phua said the agreement with the SCMP would enhance trade, investment and cultural exchanges between Hong Kong and Malaysia. [e002:f14] “By combining MayCham’s strong network with SCMP’s trusted insights and exceptional regional coverage, we aim to unlock exciting new opportunities for growth.” In addition to the SCMP, three other Hong Kong media organisations signed MOUs to collaborate. [e002:f15] Tse said the city’s media had signed a total of eight MOUs to expand their overseas business and regional influence. [e002:f16] He said the agreements marked significant progress in implementing Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu’s policy address last year, which aimed to help the media industry expand its overseas network and tell Hong Kong’s story more effectively.

evidence.title: DFDL Legal Update: New US Section 301 Tariffs on ASEAN Imports
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The Administration terminated the IEEPA-based additional ad valorem duties in February, including the former reciprocal-tariff measures; Section 232 and Section 301 duties were expressly unaffected. [e003:f02] A separate 10% temporary import surcharge imposed under Section 122 took effect on February 24 for 150 days and expired on July 24, 2026, absent congressional extension. [e003:f03] Section 301: new ASEAN country-level duties USTR’s July 23 final action in its forced-labor import-policy investigations is now the principal new country-level tariff measure affecting ASEAN. [e003:f04] For covered merchandise entered on or after July 24, 2026, Cambodia, Indonesia and Malaysia are subject to an additional 10% Section 301 duty. [e003:f05] The Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam are subject to an additional 12.5% duty. [e003:f06] Brunei Darussalam, Lao PDR, Myanmar and Timor-Leste were not among the economies covered by the action. [e003:f07] The action applies broadly to products of the covered economies, subject to exemptions identified by USTR. [e003:f08] USTR also directed the establishment, when feasible, of tariff-rate quotas for certain textile and apparel imports from Cambodia, Indonesia and Malaysia based on the use of U.S. inputs. [e003:f09] To read the full article, please visit DFDL .

evidence.title: 中国の水素生産能力、年間5100万トンを突破
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 中国国家エネルギー局が11日に発表した「中国水素エネルギー発展報告2026」によると、、中国の水素生産能力は25年末時点で前年比約1．4％増の年間5100万トンを超えた。 [e004:f02] 年間の水素生産量は同約7．3％増の3900万トンを超えた。 [e004:f03] また、中国の再生可能エネルギー由来水素製造能力は世界全体の53％を占めている。 [e004:f04] 統計によると、25年末時点で、中国で完成または建設中の再生可能エネルギー由来水素製造能力は年間100万トンを超えた。 [e004:f05] うち、稼働中の生産能力は年間25万トンを超え、24年末と比べて2倍以上に増加した。 [e004:f06] 建設中の生産能力は年間90万トンを超えており、水電解による水素製造が主要な方式となっている。 [e004:f07] これと同時に、水素エネルギーインフラについても多様化に向けた取り組みが加速している。 [e004:f08] 25年末時点で、中国では長距離純水素パイプラインが20本以上計画され、総延長は5500キロメートルを超え、稼働中の総延長は350キロメートルを超えた。 [e004:f09] 全国で累計590カ所を超える水素ステーションが建設され、燃料電池自動車の保有台数は約3万2000台に達した。 [e004:f10] 25年には全国で8000台近くの燃料電池車が新たに普及した。 [e004:f11] （提供/ 人民網日本語版 ・編集/YF） コメントを読む ※本記事はニュース提供社の記事であり、RecordChinaの立場を代表するものではありません。 [e004:f12] すべてのコンテンツの著作権は、ニュース提供社に帰属します。

evidence.title: 中国上半期のサービス小売売上高は5.3%増 消費構造は「モノ」から「コト」へ加速
evidence.body: [e005:f01] このうち、観光・コンサルティング・レンタルサービスは11.3%増、文化・スポーツ・レジャーサービスは10.4%増となりました。 [e005:f02] 中国の個人消費は、商品消費主導からサービス消費主導へと移行しつつあります。 [e005:f03] 2025年の中国の1人当たりサービス消費支出は1万3602元（約31万7000円）で、消費支出全体に占める割合は46.1%となり、2020年から3.5ポイント上昇しました。 [e005:f04] 同時期の中国のサービス業付加価値額は前年比5.4%増の80兆8879億元（約1887兆300億円）に達し、国民経済成長への寄与率は61.4%となりました。 [e005:f05] 中国国家発展改革委員会の専門家である郭春麗氏の説明によりますと、国際的な経験では、1人当たりGDPが1万5000ドル（約236万4000円）前後になると、個人消費は生存型から発展型、享受型へと高度化が加速するとされています。 [e005:f06] 現在、中国の1人当たりGDPは2020年の1万ドル台強から1万4000ドル近くまで増加しており、消費構造の転換が加速する時期にあり、サービス消費に対する需要も一段と高まっています。 [e005:f07] 一方、『中国サービス消費発展報告（2025）』は、中国の1人当たりサービス消費支出の割合（46.1%）は先進国と比べてまだ成長の余地があるとしています。 [e005:f08] 経済協力開発機構（OECD）のデータによりますと、2023年のサービス消費の割合は米国が66%、日本、フランス、英国がいずれも60%近く、ドイツが50%でした。 [e005:f09] 7月13日、中国国務院は『拡大消費「十五五」計画』を採択し、6つの分野にわたる28項目の重点施策を打ち出し、介護、保育、文化・観光、健康などのサービス消費を重要な位置付けとしました。 [e005:f10] 中国のサービス消費の成長ポテンシャルは海外からも注目を集めています。 [e005:f11] 中国欧州商工会議所天津支部の副委員長は、このほど開催されたフォーラムで、「シルバー経済（高齢者向け経済）は中国のサービス消費が持続的に成長する重要な分野である」と述べ、欧州企業がサービス消費分野で重要な貢献を果たすとの見方を示しました。 [e005:f12] (c)CGTN Japanese/AFPBB News 政治・経済 一覧へ > メディア・報道関係・法人の方向け 写真・動画 購入のお問合せ >。

evidence.title: 中国旅行が「中国ショッピング」をさらに後押し 出国時の免税申請件数が約3倍に
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 外国人観光客は市内の文化・観光スポットを次々と訪れ、中国文化をモチーフにしたグッズを競って購入しています。 [e006:f02] 今年上半期、上海の各空港・港湾から入境した旅客数は316万6000人に達し、前年同期比22％増加しました。 [e006:f03] 上海の出国時免税の申請件数は約3倍に増加し、消費額も72.9％大幅に伸びました。 [e006:f04] データによると、今年上半期、上海税関が確認した出国時免税の申請件数は25万3000件で、前年同期比約3倍となりました。 [e006:f05] 免税対象商品の購入額は23億元（約537億円）に達し、前年同期比58％増加しました。 [e006:f06] 利便性の高い決済手段と免税制度の改善が、外国人旅行者の購買意欲を大きく押し上げています。 [e006:f07] 多くの外国人観光客が、特色ある土産品を購入するため、わざわざ上海のショッピングエリアを訪れています。 [e006:f08] フランス人観光客のジュリアンさんは、「中国ではモバイル決済が非常に普及しており、現金を持ち歩く必要がないので、移動も買い物もとても便利だ」と話しました。 [e006:f09] また、ロシア人観光客のワレリアさんは、スカーフや中国風の衣装などを購入し、ワンストップで完了する免税手続きについて「素晴らしい体験だった」と語りました。 [e006:f10] 7月1日以降、上海を訪れた外国人旅行者によるアリペイ（支付宝）の決済件数は前年同期比59.2％増加し、決済額は72.9％増加しました。 [e006:f11] ウィーチャットペイ（微信支付）の1日当たりの決済件数も55％を超える伸びを記録しています。 [e006:f12] 第一百貨商業センター営業管理部の副部長、喬慧君氏は、「当施設で今年上半期に取り扱った出国時免税手続きは1万2000件を超え、前年同期比で3倍以上となりました。 [e006:f13] 免税対象商品の消費額も前年同期の2倍に増えています」と説明しました。 [e006:f14] (c)CGTN Japanese/AFPBB News 政治・経済 一覧へ > メディア・報道関係・法人の方向け 写真・動画 購入のお問合せ >。
